title: AC-24 says paqad-ai checks run blocks on a whole-tree rule script, but checks run never runs rule scripts
context: The frozen spec's AC-24 (and FR-21 / INV-10) say a failing whole-tree deterministic rule script (shaped like RL-95f2) blocks both at the completion seam and when 'paqad-ai checks run' runs. The plan's binding decision says the opposite: 'checks run has never run rule scripts (no rule-scripts import in src/checks) ... This change does not add rule scripts to checks run.' The code confirms the plan: src/checks and src/cli/commands/checks.ts never call the rule-script runner, so checks run cannot block on any rule script today. Everything else in issue 747 is built and committed; the completion-seam half of AC-24 is proven by tests (tests/unit/kernel/rule-gate-budget.test.ts and enforce.test.ts), and old vs new gate give the same blocking findings on this repo's diff. Only the checks-run half of AC-24 is open.
